mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'gas' AS type, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(result = 'FAIL') AS fail FROM mes_set_gas_record WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'dust' , COUNT(*), SUM(result = 'FAIL') FROM mes_set_dust_record WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'noise' , COUNT(*), SUM(result = 'FAIL') FROM mes_set_noise_record WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'wastewater' , COUNT(*), SUM(result = 'FAIL') FROM mes_set_wastewater WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'exhaust' , COUNT(*), SUM(result = 'FAIL') FROM mes_set_exhaust_gas WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'electrical' , COUNT(*), SUM(result = 'FAIL') FROM mes_set_electrical_record WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'fire' , COUNT(*), SUM(result = 'FAIL') FROM mes_set_fire_check WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'chemical' , COUNT(*), SUM(result = 'FAIL') FROM mes_set_chemical_safety WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ppe' , COUNT(*), SUM(result = 'FAIL') FROM mes_set_ppe_check WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'occupational', COUNT(*), SUM(result = 'FAIL') FROM mes_set_occupational_hazard WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'pressure' , COUNT(*), SUM(result = 'FAIL') FROM mes_set_pressure_vessel WHERE deleted = 0 ) t GROUP BY type, total, fail ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_set_standard WHERE deleted = 0) AS standardCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_set_plan WHERE deleted = 0) AS planCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_set_plan WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE') AS planActiveCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_set_emission_outlet WHERE deleted = 0) AS outletCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_set_pollution_permit WHERE deleted = 0) AS permitCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_set_hazardous_waste WHERE deleted = 0) AS wasteCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_set_env_report WHERE deleted = 0) AS envReportCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_set_carbon_emission WHERE deleted = 0) AS carbonCount, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(total_emission) FROM mes_set_carbon_emission WHERE deleted = 0), 0) AS carbonEmissionSum
